facts.fact: The historic yellow trams connect the centre to Santa Teresa.
The departure point is on Rua Lélio Gama near Carioca metro station.
The route crosses Arcos da Lapa; Largo do Curvelo and Largo dos Guimarães are described stops.

title: Riotur — Os Bondinhos de Santa Teresa
